svg.text: Self-Evolving AI Architecture on Google Cloud Agent Platform
Synthesizing APEX (Tri-Level Co-Evolution) • AgentEvolver (Shapley Attribution) • Dream-RSI (BigQuery Counterfactual Replay)

g.text: • Compiled in RAM (Zero disk file edits)
• Cold stampede drops hit ratio to 0.0%

svg.text: ZONE 2: GOOGLE CLOUD AGENT PLATFORM (ADK 2.0 & GEMINI 4.0 ARGON)

g.text: • Ingests sanitized alerts & synthesizes L1 hotpatches
• Dynamically routes across sub_agents DAG in RAM

svg.text: ZONE 3: SELF-EVOLUTION ENGINE (AGENTEVOLVER • APEX L2 • DREAM-RSI)

g.text: • Static AST check blocks os, sys, socket, eval
• Signs both L1 Python hotpatches and L2
• Pauses runtime before DAG topology mutation

svg.text: An AI agent may autonomously evolve its operational tactics to defend system health, but its authority to execute is cryptographically bounded by Cloud KMS, OPA Policy Controller, and human SRE custody.
